analysis_plan.null_hypothesis: x and date together do not predict y
analysis_plan.alternative_hypothesis: x and date together predict y
analysis_plan.method_rationale: The research question asks for a multiple regression using x and date together to predict y. However, none of the supported methods allow for multiple predictors (i.e., more than one predictor variable). The supported methods only include simple linear regression (which uses one predictor) and do not support multiple regression. Therefore, no supported method can be used to answer this question.
design_notes: The study is observational and not randomized, so any associations found should be interpreted as such and not as causal relationships.

The variables x and y are numeric, and date is a date variable. Multiple regression would require converting the date variable into a numeric form (e.g., days since a reference date) to include it as a predictor.
